test_title: PYST 49: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A cyclist covers a distance of 2.5 km in 4 minutes 10 seconds. How long will he take to cover a distance of 12 km at the same speed?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance covered by the cyclist = 2.5 km

Time taken to cover 2.5 km = 4 minutes 10 seconds = 4 × 60 + 10 = 250 seconds

Distance to be covered = 12 km

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Speed of the cyclist = 2.5 / 250 km/s

⇒ Speed = 0.01 km/s

The time taken to cover 12 km

Time = Distance / Speed

⇒ Time = 12 / 0.01 seconds

⇒ Time = 1200 seconds

Time = 1200 / 60 minutes

⇒ Time = 20 minutes

**The cyclist will take 20 minutes to cover 12 km at the same speed.**
